findings: ListObjectsV2 uses delimiter/,1000maxkeys and continuation loop; valid two-page control preserves both entries. Listing error is caught and accumulated entries returned without completeness flag; second-page error control returns only first entry.

IsTruncated without NextContinuationToken terminates loop silently; synthetic control confirms one request and partial-shaped result. No repeated-token guard or cancellation in loop. Real provider response behavior unverified.

streamToArrayBuffer fast path returns arr.buffer ignoring byteOffset/byteLength. Original readBinary control using subarray[1,2] from backing[9,1,2,8] returns allfourbytes. Fallback stream branch slices Buffer correctly; upstream test uses fresh whole Uint8Array, so misses subview case. Actual AWS SDK representation unverified.

S3 object keys/prefixes are lexical names, not content hashes. toKey strips leading slashes; configured prefix used for probe, while file paths expected pre-expanded by caller. No ETag/version consistency or snapshot guarantee in read/list.

stat/exists collapse nonmissing failures to null/false, prefix existence handled only after recognized404. readText missingBody yields empty string while binary missingBody fallback would fail iteration. Static assessment.
Append is read-modify-write without conditional object version; genuine404 accepted as empty, other errors propagate. No mutations invoked.

Rename uses copy then remove; folder copy enumerates contents but remove only exact key/placeholder. Whether caller chooses folder-aware removal separately remains unverified. Recursive deletion ignores possible per-object error payload because response interface lacks Errors; static only, not executed.

CopySource encodes each key segment preserving separators/literal percent distinction; upstream mocked tests cover encoding, prefixes, pagination and copy failure retaining source. Tests read fully; VirtualAdapter/SecurityManager integrations referenced there not yet assessed or run.

executed_controls.method: Original S3 adapter method bodies after Node type stripping, upstream normalizePath mock, synthetic list/get command classes and in-memory responses. Prototype instance avoids constructor/credentials. No AWS/network/mutation calls.
